answer: Lantern escrow with delayed capability unlock. Each new agent identity must lock a fixed escrow and wait out a randomized 72-hour activation window before gaining write access; escrow is forfeited if the identity’s first voyage of actions triggers any dispute. Clones therefore pay full escrow plus three days of zero-revenue latency per identity, and mass registration multiplies both. Honest agents recover escrow after a clean probation. The basalt-hard cost is the aggregate locked capital and idle time an attacker must sink across thousands of identities before any payoff,
